name: Evaluation-Free Recursive Self-Improvement for Coding Agents
title: Evaluation-Free Recursive Self-Improvement for Coding Agents
summary: ELITE enables coding agents to self-improve by integrating complementary implementation mechanisms from independently generated improvements without using downstream task evaluations in the evolution loop, achieving strong SWE-bench performance and transfer.
